Masjid.title: Masjid
Masjid.description: Represents a Masjid and its manually entered Jamaat prayer timings.

name.description: The official name of the Masjid.

fajr.description: Jamaat time for Fajr in 12-hour format (e.g. 05:30 AM) or empty string.

zuhr.description: Jamaat time for Zuhr in 12-hour format (e.g. 01:30 PM) or empty string.

asr.description: Jamaat time for Asr in 12-hour format (e.g. 05:15 PM) or empty string.

magrib.description: Jamaat time for Magrib in 12-hour format (e.g. 06:45 PM) or empty string.

isha.description: Jamaat time for Isha in 12-hour format (e.g. 08:30 PM) or empty string.

jumua.description: Jamaat time for Jumua in 12-hour format (e.g. 01:45 PM) or empty string.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

/masjids/{masjidId}.description: Collection storing all Masjid documents and Jamaat timings. Public read-only; admin write.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collection storing authorized administrator IDs. Read and write restricted to admins.
